scripts.dev: concurrently -n db,api,web -c blue,green,yellow "pnpm dev:db" "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:web"
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && python -m alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d postgres && ping -n 6 127.0.0.1 >nul && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm seed
scripts.seed: cd apps/api && python -c "import asyncio; from db.seed import seed_dev_users; asyncio.run(seed_dev_users())"
